bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH LATE TONIGHT... Combined seas 10 to 14 ft becoming 20 to 24 ft Friday evening. Bar conditions rough becoming severe. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 630 AM Friday, 630 PM Friday, and 715 AM Saturday.
